topArticle.title: Men deported from US bound and beaten in Equatorial Guinea detention hotel, lawyers say
topArticle.description:
Group trapped at Hotel Bamy after US removal as rights groups sound alarm over poor conditions and violence

Two men that the Trump administration expelled to Equatorial Guinea were bound, fitted with bags over their heads, beaten and pushed down a flight of stairs, all in plain view of other US deportees, according to witnesses and human rights lawyers.
The men – one from Egypt and one from Eritrea – were then taken to a prison. About 30 detainees from the US remain trapped at a hotel in the outskirts of the coastal city of Malabo after being deported from the US. Detainees have said they believe the men were beaten for telling the press and human rights advocates about the poor conditions and violence inside the hotel, and that they are haunted by flashbacks and terrified they will be retaliated against next.

topArticle.title: New cat species identified for first time in more than a century in Bolivia
topArticle.description:
New species of wild feline was discovered in Bolivia’s Yungas forest that is smaller than the average domestic ⁠cat
A diminutive wild cat that inhabits Bolivia’s ⁠cloud forest has been identified as a previously unknown species, marking the first time a new living feline species has been formally named and described in more than a century.
The cat, called tilcayo by local communities, is part of a group called tiger ⁠cats found across much of South ⁠America. It was found in Bolivia’s ​lush Yungas forest, a mountainous region where forests are often covered by clouds and surrounded by high humidity, according to researchers. It measures about 18in (46cm) long and weighs about 3lb (1.4kg), making it smaller than the average domestic ⁠cat.

topArticle.title: Battle of Chile director Patricio Guzmán dies aged 85
topArticle.description:
Passionate documentary maker  won international acclaim for unsparing but poetic films exploring the impact of the Pinochet regime in Chile 
Patricio Guzmán, the film-maker who chronicled Chile’s bloody 1970s political strife and its subsequent social and political turmoil in films such as The Battle of Chile and Nostalgia for the Light, has died aged 85. According to Chilean news outlet Emol, Guzmán died on Tuesday in Paris after a cardiorespiratory arrest.
Guzmán’s chief preoccupation throughout his career was the carnage unleashed by Augusto Pinochet’s coup in 1973 against Salvador Allende, Chile’s elected president. He later told the Guardian: “I’m a film-maker who was very marked by the ways of the dictator. It has remained with me for ever. I cannot leave it behind.” However, he resisted the idea that he was an activist, political film-maker, adding: “I’m not a sociologist. Neither am I a politician. I make films that are metaphorical and poetic; I interpret reality through my own personal way of looking.”

topArticle.titleJa: ベネズエラの地震から1ヶ月以上：「息子が見つかるまでここを離れない」
topArticle.summary: ベネズエラの地震から1ヶ月以上経ち、ラ・グアイラでは数千人の親族が劣悪な状況と不十分な支援の中、倒壊した建物のそばで捜索を続けている。

topArticle.title: Trump's response is key as Argentina's Falklands demands get louder
topArticle.description: With Argentina's President Milei promising "winds of change" over the Falklands, will Donald Trump shift his stance on British rule?
topArticle.titleJa: アルゼンチンのフォークランド諸島要求が高まる中、トランプ氏の反応が鍵に
topArticle.summary: アルゼンチンのミレイ大統領がフォークランド諸島に関する「変化の風」を約束する中、ドナルド・トランプ氏が英国統治に対する姿勢を変えるかどうかが注目されている。

topArticle.title: Ecuador detains former minister José Serrano after U.S. deportation
topArticle.description: Deported from the United States, Ecuador’s former “superminister” now faces grave criminal investigations and political accusations in a justice system facing questions over due process.
topArticle.titleJa: エクアドルが元大臣ホセ・セラーノを米国からの強制送還後に拘束
topArticle.summary: 米国から強制送還されたエクアドルの元「スーパー大臣」ホセ・セラーノが、重大な刑事捜査と政治的告発に直面。司法制度の適正手続きも問われている。

topArticle.title: Weaponizing citizenship: Silencing dissent in Nicaragua
topArticle.description: In this edition, we examine an authoritarian narrative making the case for denationalization in Nicaragua.
topArticle.titleJa: 市民権の武器化：ニカラグアにおける異議申し立ての沈黙
topArticle.summary: ニカラグアでは、権威主義的な言説が国籍剥奪を正当化し、反体制派の声を封じ込めるために市民権が武器として使われている状況を検証する。

topArticle.title: Nepal to use new flood study to claim millions from UN climate disaster fund
topArticle.description: A new study says climate change was a likely factor in the massive flood on the Nepal-Tibet border last month.
topArticle.titleJa: ネパール、新たな洪水研究に基づき国連気候災害基金から数百万ドルを請求へ
topArticle.summary: ネパール政府は、先月のネパール・チベット国境での大規模洪水が気候変動に起因するとする研究を用い、国連気候災害基金に数百万ドルを請求する方針だ。
